content.short: Indicaton is an analytics and design tool on TON that provides insights into dApp UI/UX and engagement.
content.description: Indicaton is a specialized analytical tool and creative framework designed to improve the user experience of decentralized applications on the TON blockchain. It provides developers and projects with deep insights into design trends, user engagement metrics, and UI/UX performance across the network. By identifying the most effective visual and interactive patterns, Indicaton helps projects optimize their applications for better user retention and ease of use. It is an essential resource for teams looking to build high-quality and user-friendly products that resonate with the global TON audience.
content.meta: Optimize your TON dApp with Indicaton's design and analytics tools. Data-driven UX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
